Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 067. 最大的异或

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Trie {
public:
    vector<Trie*> children;
    string v;
    Trie()
        : children(2) {}

    void insert(int x) {
        Trie* node = this;
        for (int i = 30; ~i; --i) {
            int v = (x >> i) & 1;
            if (!node->children[v]) node->children[v] = new Trie();
            node = node->children[v];
        }
    }

    int search(int x) {
        Trie* node = this;
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 30; ~i; --i) {
            int v = (x >> i) & 1;
            if (node->children[v ^ 1]) {
                res = res << 1 | 1;
                node = node->children[v ^ 1];
            } else {
                res <<= 1;
                node = node->children[v];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
};

class Solution {
public:
    int findMaximumXOR(vector<int>& nums) {
        Trie* trie = new Trie();
        int ans = 0;
        for (int v : nums) {
            trie->insert(v);
            ans = max(ans, trie->search(v));
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
